You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Alejandra Schmitz. Street artist. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Knife roll, Mother's Ring, Busker's harmonica, Daughter's Drawing, Dog tags. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.
